text_block_list.text:
...Hm. I guess it's time to replace my
tracksuit.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It feels tight in some places when I
move. Looks
like I gained some muscle.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As always, meat reigns supreme.
It's good
for your muscles, no doubt
about it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Curious, I take a look at the results of
this
morning's physical, and...
choice_data_list:
Your muscle mass seems to have dropped a bit,
actually...

text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: In other words, the increase is...

text_block_list.text: And wipe that smirk off your face! Argh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан gets back into shape after
some
grueling runs.
